title: Application Load Balancer with multiple AWS Lambda functions as a target
description: Create an Application Load Balancer with Lambda functions as targets

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern shows how to create an Application Load Balancer with path-based routing along with associated listener and target as AWS Lambda. Implemented in AWS CDK .NET.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.

authors.name: Pushparaju Thangavel
authors.bio: Pushparaju is a Cloud Infrastructure Architect with Amazon Web Services
